data.text: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom,(u) laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa-laa nawm,(un) lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa-maa fil ard:(i) man zal lazee yashfa'u indahooo illaa bi-iznih,(i) ya'lamu maa baina aydeehim wa-maa khalfahum; wa-laa yuheetoona bishai'im min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaaa',(a) wasi'a Kursiyyuhus samaawaati wal-ard(a); wa-laa Ya'ooduhoo hifzuhum,(aa) wa-Huwal Aliyyul 'Azeem
